title: Detroit Belle Isle Highlights Tour with Private Transportation
blurb: Discover the beauty, history, and hidden gems of Belle Isle on this private guided tour. Located on the Detroit River between the United States and Canada, Belle Isle is a 982-acre island park designed by legendary landscape architect Frederick Law Olmsted, co-designer of New York City's Central Park. Travel with your private guide-driver as you explore Belle Isle's most famous landmarks, historic buildings, scenic waterfronts, and skyline views. Visit the James Scott Memorial Fountain, America's oldest public aquarium, one of the nation's oldest botanical conservatories, the Dossin Great Lakes Museum, the country's only marble lighthouse, Belle Isle Beach, and scenic viewpoints overlooking Detroit and Windsor. Admission is included whenever attractions are open. If an attraction is closed, your guide-driver will provide an exterior visit with historical commentary.
